# Fox Founder AI

> A boutique studio founded by Krishna Nartam in Pune, India, building AI products, n8n automation systems, and Industrial IoT dashboards — from first prompt to production.

Fox Founder AI designs and ships production software for startups, scale-ups, and small manufacturers. Work spans LLM applications (chat surfaces, retrieval pipelines, multi-step agents), workflow and ops automation built on n8n, real-time Industrial IoT telemetry dashboards, and full-stack product development.

Founder: Krishna Prashant Nartam — AI Engineer, mechanical engineering background, based in Pune, Maharashtra, India. Works remotely with teams across timezones.
